blocks.text: Where money sleeps at night. Safe, boring, and absolutely critical.
You sold a house. You have ₹1 Crore. You need it in 6 months to buy a new house. Where do you put it?

Savings-account rates and inflation vary over time. Compare the actual rate, access terms, fees, and tax treatment.
✅ Money Market?
Money-market products have different yields, credit risks, price risks, and redemption terms. Do not treat a fund as risk-free or assume immediate access.
blocks.title: ❌ Savings Account?

blocks.text: If money is earmarked for a known expense, first match the instrument’s maturity and withdrawal terms to the date you need the cash. A higher expected yield may come with credit, price, or access risk that matters more than the headline rate.
blocks.title: 🗓️ Match the Parking Period

blocks.text: This market is where Banks, Governments, and Giants borrow cash for 1 to 364 days.

items: T-Bills (Treasury Bills): You lend to the Govt of India for 91, 182, or 364 days. Sovereign credit risk is generally low, but market-price, liquidity, reinvestment, and inflation risks can still matter when you sell or hold a security.
CP (Commercial Paper): Companies issue commercial paper for short-term funding. The investor faces issuer credit and liquidity risk; access and minimum investment depend on the instrument and venue.

CD (Certificate of Deposit): Banks issue certificates of deposit under instrument-specific terms. Check issuer, maturity, credit and liquidity risks; deposits and certificates of deposit are not identical products.

blocks.text: A T-bill is a short-term government borrowing instrument. Commercial paper and certificates of deposit are issued by companies and banks, so their credit and liquidity risks differ. Identify the issuer before treating two short-term products as equivalent.
blocks.title: 🧾 Read the Borrower

blocks.text: A liquid fund invests in short-term debt and money-market instruments under its mandate. Its NAV can fluctuate and returns are not guaranteed.

Redemption timing and any instant-access facility depend on the scheme, platform, cut-off time, limits, and settlement rules. A liquid fund is not a bank savings account and does not promise a higher return.

Fund redemption timing, cut-off times, settlement, and instant-access limits depend on the scheme and service. A fund’s portfolio value can fluctuate, and a straight-looking historical chart does not make the investment a bank deposit.
blocks.title: 💧 Liquidity Is a Condition

blocks.text:
Tax treatment depends on the product, holding period, and current tax law. Check the latest official guidance before investing; do not choose a fund on an assumed tax advantage alone.
Strategy: Arbitrage funds carry market, execution, liquidity, and return risk. Their suitability depends on your time horizon, access needs, costs, and current tax treatment.
blocks.title: ☠️ GOD MODE: Arbitrage Funds

blocks.text: Confirm the investment horizon, access rules, credit quality, interest-rate exposure, expense ratio, and tax treatment. Compare the after-tax outcome and the chance of delayed access, not just the advertised or recent yield.
